confirm.backup_create: A backup will be created for the selected disk. If the free quota is exceeded, payment starts only after you confirm the quote.

confirm.ip_change: The old address may stop working immediately. Make sure your service is ready for the change.
confirm.nat_create: This exposes a port forwarding rule. Confirm the ports and protocol do not expose an unintended service.
confirm.nat_delete: The corresponding port forwarding stops immediately.
confirm.reboot: Rebooting briefly interrupts service. A forced reboot may lose unsaved data.
confirm.reinstall: Reinstalling overwrites the current system. Enabling data-disk formatting also erases those disks. This cannot be undone.
confirm.reset_password: The old password stops working immediately after this succeeds.
confirm.resize: A configuration change may require a reboot and may incur charges.
confirm.security_group_attach: Network access rules may change immediately. Confirm required connections will remain available.

confirm.snapshot_delete: This snapshot cannot be recovered after deletion.
confirm.snapshot_restore: Restoring overwrites current disk data. Review the impact and enter the current service number.
confirm.start: Confirm that you want to start this server.
confirm.stop: Stopping interrupts every service on this server. A forced stop may lose unsaved data.
confirm.traffic_add: Buying traffic may incur a charge. It takes effect only after quote confirmation and payment.
confirm.virtual_media_mount: Mounting changes the installation media visible to the server. Confirm the running service allows it.
confirm.virtual_media_unmount: The server can no longer access this virtual media after unmounting.

transfer.confirmDescription: After confirmation, server {serviceNo} moves to your account. The former customer's historical invoices, payments, refunds, contracts, tax invoices, and tickets stay with them. Paid and still-valid snapshots or backups that belong only to this server move with it. Auto-renew is turned off, and you may enable it again if needed.
transfer.confirmFailed: The transfer cannot be completed now. It may have expired, or the server may have an unpaid renewal or add-on invoice, refund or operation in progress.
transfer.confirmed: The server was transferred to your account.
transfer.description: Enter the recipient's registered and verified email. The same accepted response is shown whether or not the email exists. The recipient must confirm within 24 hours. Resolve unpaid renewal and add-on invoices first; auto-renew is turned off after transfer.
transfer.failed: The transfer could not be submitted. Check that the merchant allows transfers and resolve unpaid renewal or add-on invoices, refunds, and active operations.
transfer.title: Transfer server to another customer
